g.title: poc_precice_detailed_pathway
g.text: UNST-9075 preCICE proof of concept (PoC @ 0f9c6de2c5): what the source actually does
Solid = exists in source. Dashed red = broken, unverified or absent. Nothing here is a validated bidirectional run.

g.title: cluster_gaps
g.text: Not established or defective (see the Markdown report)

g.title: cfg
g.text: participants fm, wave; meshes fm_flow_nodes, wave_nodes
found at the hard-coded path ../precice_config.xml in BOTH codes

g.title: w2
g.text: get_swan_grid reads FIRST Grid= of the mdw (195)
vertices where kcs == 1, 2 triangles per fully active quad

g.title: g1
g.text: Rank 0 / size 1 passed to preCICE for wave in every case,
because the call precedes MPI initialisation

g.title: pc
g.text: preCICE: serial-explicit, one exchange per window

g.title: f5
g.text: hrms tp pdir fx fy wsbodyu/v mx my ubot dissip2/3

g.title: g2
g.text: Only grid 1 is registered, read and written:

g.title: g3
g.text: BMI / DIMR route: wave_bmi.f90:144-148 passes a local,
never-created state; unstruc_bmi.F90:250,327 passes a dummy
state to flowinit, which then creates a participant

g.title: g4
g.text: Legacy com-file write-back and ESMF mapping removed, not guarded
precicef_* calls and the config are unconditional

g.title: credit
g.text: Created with Copilot from source reading; no run of the PoC was performed.
